# Perfumerías Primor

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Spanish perfume and cosmetics retailer with an online store on Magento and physical shops. Sells perfumes, makeup, skincare, hair care, body care and parapharmacy. Its shipping page states home delivery to the Peninsula and the Balearic Islands and in-store pickup.

*ES:* Perfumería y cosmética española con tienda online en Magento y tiendas físicas. Vende perfumes, maquillaje, cosmética, cabello, cuidado corporal y parafarmacia. Su página de envíos indica entrega a domicilio en Península y Baleares y recogida en tienda.
